jobs.title: Director of Pharma Partnerships, Patient Recruitment
jobs.description: About myTomorrows myTomorrows is a global health tech company dedicated to breaking down barriers for patients seeking treatment options. We strive to enable earlier and better treatment access by bridging the gap between those searching for possible options, and the companies who develop them. We work closely with patients, healthcare professionals, trial sites, patient advocacy groups, and BioPharma – connecting key stakeholders in the drug development ecosystem. We’ve developed a cutting-edge AI-powered technology platform that simplifies and streamlines access to drugs in development. To support our users and clients, we have a range of industry-expert specialized teams ready to help. Our services include clinical trial patient recruitment, Expanded Access Program management and Real-World Data collection. With a global footprint spanning 134 countries, to date we’ve supported over 17,000 patients, 3,000 physicians and 350 sites, earning the trust of 60+ BioPharma companies. In October 2025, we closed a €25M investment with Avego Healthcare Capital to fuel our global ambitions and scale the business. Join us in shaping the future of treatment access - making tomorrow’s therapies accessible for people who need them today. The opportunity: Director of Pharma Partnerships, Patient Recruitment As Director of Pharma Partnerships, you will play a pivotal role in driving revenue growth through partnerships with Biopharmaceutical Companies related to myTomorrows' Patient Recruitment products and services for clinical trials. You will be responsible for generating leads and establishing partnerships and alliances that support our business objectives and enhance our clinical trial portfolio. You will develop and own strategic collaborations with BioPharma companies, from emerging innovators to global leaders, driving measurable revenue growth through our Patient Recruitment solutions and expanding our market footprint. Success in this role requires a sharp commercial mind

We are united by a single vision to help people live longer healthier lives, using the power of genomics. jobs.title: Clinical Quality Consultant
jobs.description: Clinical Quality Consultant In Brief We're a rapidly growing startup on a mission to make healthcare proactive by empowering physicians, nurses, and care team members with real-time data to save lives. You'll support product quality for an FDA-cleared, AI-driven clinical platform, from complaint investigation once it's live in hospitals, to the quality system and regulatory record that hold it all together. Who We Are Bayesian Health's mission is to improve patient outcomes by empowering clinicians with the insights they need to make the right decision for the right patient at the point of care. We're a diverse team of clinicians, engineers, AI experts, product designers, and performance improvement leaders committed to enabling smarter, patient-specific care delivery through unlocking the power of data. We're funded by top tier tech and biotech investors: Obvious Ventures, Andreessen Horowitz, American Medical Association's venture arm, Catalio Partners, and LifeForce Capital. Recent recognitions include Forbes AI Top 50, World Economic Forum Tech Pioneer, Time Best Inventions, and BioTech AI Company of the Year. Read more about our peer-reviewed research in Nature Medicine associating our products with improved patient outcomes. About the Role When a care team asks why an alert did or did not fire, that question comes to our Clinical Production Support team, and answering it well takes real clinical judgment. Clinical case reviews are the largest share of that work and the heart of this role. You will investigate what happened in a given encounter, reach a sound and defensible conclusion, and communicate it clearly to the clinicians and client teams who asked. Strong clinical reasoning is the foundation. On top of it, you will build a working understanding of how the product behaves, including how flags are generated, how suppression logic works, and how data moves from the EHR into the model. GI is our WHY and for more than 30 years that purpose has driven our scientific rigour, operational excellence, and deep therapeutic expertise, including supporting more than 70% of IBD compounds in development. jobs.title: Consultant Neurologist (Remote, Ireland)
jobs.description: Our patients have often tried everything. Years of appointments, medications that did not work, conditions that slowly took over their lives. By the time they reach us, many have run out of road with conventional treatment. You could be the clinician that changes that. We are Montu UK, one of the UK's largest medical cannabis clinics, and we are looking for Consultant Neurologists to join our clinical team. About the role You will assess and manage patients exploring cannabis based medicines, making the clinical call on whether treatment is appropriate and managing their care from there. This is still a young field. The evidence base is growing, best practice is being written in real time, and you will have a genuine hand in shaping it. You do not need experience with cannabis based medicines. You need sound clinical judgement, an open mind and an interest in doing things differently. We provide full specialist training, and our multidisciplinary model means you are never working in isolation. Nurses and pharmacists handle pre consultation and follow up tasks, so your time is spent where it matters: with patients. What you will be doing: Providing high quality care for patients seeking medical cannabis treatment Conducting patient consultations, including assessment and ongoing management Contributing to clinical outcome data collection to support evidence based practice Supporting clinical governance and maintaining robust standards of patient care Working closely within a multidisciplinary team of nurses and pharmacists Taking part in ongoing training and development, including bespoke specialist training in cannabis based medicines (CBPMs) What you need: Full valid GMC Registration Completion of Specialist Training (CCST/CCT) or equivalent certification On the GMC Specialist Register for Neurology A genuine interest in alternative therapies Willingness to participate in data collection and reporting Why join us? jobs.title: Consultant Psychiatrist (Remote, Ireland)
jobs.description: Our patients have often reached a point where they feel they have run out of options. Many have spent years living with anxiety, depression, PTSD, ADHD or other complex mental health conditions, trying multiple medications and therapies with little success. By the time they reach us, they are looking for a clinician willing to listen, think differently and explore another evidence based treatment option. You could be the clinician that changes that. We are Montu UK, one of the UK's largest medical cannabis clinics, and we are looking for Consultant Psychiatrists to join our clinical team. About the role You will assess and manage patients exploring cannabis based medicines, making the clinical decision on whether treatment is appropriate and managing their care from there. This is an evolving area of medicine where the evidence base continues to grow, giving you the opportunity to contribute to a field that is developing rapidly. You do not need previous experience with cannabis based medicines. We are looking for experienced Psychiatrists with excellent clinical judgement, curiosity and an open minded approach to patient care. We provide comprehensive specialist training, and our multidisciplinary model means you are never working in isolation. Nurses and pharmacists complete pre consultation and follow up prescribing tasks, allowing you to focus on clinical decision making and delivering outstanding patient care. What you will be doing: Provide high quality care for patients seeking medical cannabis treatment. Conduct patient consultations, including assessment and ongoing management. Engage in clinical outcome data collection to support evidence based practices. Contribute to clinical governance and maintain robust patient care standards. Collaborate effectively within a multidisciplinary team, including nurses and pharmacists. Participate in ongoing training and professional development, including bespoke specialist training in cannabis based medicines (CBMPs).
